# fix-cs2-wayland

> One-command fix for two related CS2 (Counter-Strike 2, native Linux) bugs on
> Wayland desktops. Made for the Ubuntu Steam Snap. Also works with native and
> Flatpak Steam installs. Bash only. No root. No Python. Fully reversible.

Version: v1.1.0. License: MIT.

## Problem and fix

CS2 does not start with `SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER=wayland` on the Ubuntu Steam Snap.
Reason: the Snap sets `DISABLE_WAYLAND=1` and
`XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$UID/snap.steam`. The Snap does not put the real
Wayland socket in that directory. The Steam container runtime
(`SteamLinuxRuntime_sniper`, pressure-vessel) then does not mount the socket
into the game container. So CS2 runs in XWayland instead. There, the SDL3
library inside CS2 has an XInput2 bug: the mouse stays near the screen center
at some starts.

The script fixes this with three steps:

1. Creates `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/snap.steam/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY -> ../$WAYLAND_DISPLAY`
   and installs a user systemd unit that rebuilds it at each login.
2. Patches `SteamLinuxRuntime_sniper/_v2-entry-point` to create the same
   symlink before pressure-vessel runs.
3. Sets `SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER=wayland` in `game/cs2.sh` (Wayland sessions only).

The script saves a `.backup-before-wayland-fix` copy next to every file it
changes. `--revert` restores all files and removes the unit and symlink.

## Main documents

- [README.md](README.md): full documentation. Symptoms, root causes, media of
  the bug, upstream fix status, install, usage, display-mode notes,
  troubleshooting, tested-on list.
- [fix-cs2-wayland](fix-cs2-wayland): the script. Actions: default (apply),
  `--status`, `--revert`, `--force`, `--version`, `--help`.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT license text.
- [community-post.md](community-post.md): ready-to-paste texts for the Valve
  issue thread and for a Reddit post.
- [cs2-display-test.py](cs2-display-test.py): interactive cross-platform
  VSync/VRR test assistant. It writes a Markdown report and changes nothing.

## Key facts for answers

- Mouse bug upstream issues:
  [csgo-osx-linux#4354](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/csgo-osx-linux/issues/4354)
  and [libsdl-org/SDL#16163](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/issues/16163).
  The SDL fix merged 2026-09-10 (SDL 3.4.18). It does not reach CS2, because
  CS2 uses its own copy at `game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/libSDL3.so.0`.
- Socket issue upstream: [steam-runtime#857](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/steam-runtime/issues/857),
  closed 2026-10-23. The runtime ships SDL 3.4.18 now, but CS2 is still
  affected for the reason above.
- Display mode: on the Wayland driver, the CS2 video menu offers only
  `Windowed` and `Fullscreen Windowed`. Borderless (`fullscreen=0`,
  `nowindowborder=1`) is the correct mode. The author tested it on
  2026-11-01: no input lag, no stuck mouse. Plain exclusive `Fullscreen`
  appears in the menu only on XWayland, where it had lag problems.
- Original bug report: r/cs2 thread by u/Pretty_Library_2373, May 14 2026,
  <https://www.reddit.com/r/cs2/comments/1td29d6/mouse_bug_linux_native/>.
  Video: <https://v.redd.it/tnzdwqp6i41h1>. This repo uses the video and
  screenshots with credit and removes them on author request.
